description: Rules for regenerating Friends of Opus Formosa static OPENTIX seat maps. OPENTIX admin seat data remains the source of truth for seats that are not matched by Friends VIP rules. Friends VIP rules have highest priority and override any OPENTIX section, price, status, youth, reserved, unavailable, or excluded-seat data. Do not store OPENTIX credentials or tokens in this file; use local environment variables or GitHub Actions secrets.

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: all fetched seats, sections, prices, youth seats, reserved seats, unavailable seats, and excluded seats
any seat matched by sectionOverrides.match.sectionIds or sectionOverrides.match.seatSelectors
rulePrecedence.effect: override OPENTIX data with the rule display name, kind, price, color, and source

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: any Friends VIP seat matched by seatStatusOverrides.match.seatSelectors
rulePrecedence.effect: keep the Friends VIP style and add a taken marker so the seat is visibly crossed out
if a public seat's OPENTIX status is no longer available, keep its public ticket-section style and add a taken marker

publicSeatStatusOverlay.effect: Use public OPENTIX seat status as the availability source because it updates sold/unavailable seats more reliably than the admin sections/seats response. Seat sections, prices, and SVG still come from the admin API.

alreadyUnavailableWithinCurrentRuleBefor.note: These seats are also covered by the current 3600 VIP rule but were already unavailable or manually held before the 8/7 10:30 pull evidence window.
